origin: Original geometric outlines created independently for Aincrad UI SC hexagrams, 2026; no font outlines extracted from Unicode charts, primary-text illustrations, SAOUI, or external fonts.
design_note: All 64 hexagram symbols are absent from the local Source Han Sans SC Regular and Medium face 2. Six horizontal rows are newly constructed from rectangles, with shared proportions related to the existing eight trigram signs. The data records define all top-to-bottom line identities; no chart glyph outline was traced.

geometry.fourteen_px_note: Expanded vertical occupancy after actual rasterization exposed merged rows in compact drafts. At 14 px: Regular line thickness 0.784 px and clearance 1.652 px; Medium 0.84 px and clearance 1.596 px. A fixed 25% row-projection diagnostic on all 64 native 14px CFF glyphs detected six separated bands in both styles. This environment-specific diagnostic is not universal legibility or device acceptance.
